      • hopWorld

        public static boolean hopWorld​(int world,
                               boolean combatCheck)
        Uses the in game hopper to change worlds Note: This does choose the option to not ask again.
        Parameters:
        world - integer value of world to hop to, <300 value or literal world value accepted (eg 1 vs 301)
        combatCheck - false will ignore the combat check for the hopper, default value from base methods is true.
        Returns:
        false if in combat, true if by the end of the method your world is your target world.

      • dcHop

        public static boolean dcHop​(int world)
        If you're logged in, it will force a disconnect before forcing a world change. If you're logged out, it will just change the world directly.
        Parameters:
        world - world to hop to (if over 300, it will decrease the world by 300 to find the proper id)
        Returns:
        true if successfully changes world, else false
